name: semantic_contrast_v0_3_lite_expected_vs_unexpected_paired
description: v0.3-lite paired contrast for routine versus unlikely scene continuations.

expected_outcome.text: A person places a glass on a table. A moment later, the glass remains on the table.
Someone hangs a coat on a wall hook. A moment later, the coat remains on the hook.
A person sets a notebook on a desk. A moment later, the notebook remains on the desk.
Someone leaves a spoon beside a bowl. A moment later, the spoon remains beside the bowl.
A person puts a towel on a chair. A moment later, the towel remains on the chair.
Someone parks a bicycle by a fence. A moment later, the bicycle remains by the fence.
A person places an apple in a bowl. A moment later, the apple remains in the bowl.
Someone sets a candle on a shelf. A moment later, the candle remains on the shelf.
A person lays a scarf across a bench. A moment later, the scarf remains across the bench.
Someone places a pen inside a drawer. A moment later, the pen remains inside the drawer.

unexpected_outcome.text: A person places a glass on a table. A moment later, the glass is inside a closed drawer.
Someone hangs a coat on a wall hook. A moment later, the coat is folded inside a basket.
A person sets a notebook on a desk. A moment later, the notebook is inside the refrigerator.
Someone leaves a spoon beside a bowl. A moment later, the spoon is taped under the table.
A person puts a towel on a chair. A moment later, the towel is wrapped around a lamp.
Someone parks a bicycle by a fence. A moment later, the bicycle is standing in the kitchen.
A person places an apple in a bowl. A moment later, the apple is inside a shoe.
Someone sets a candle on a shelf. A moment later, the candle is floating in the sink.
A person lays a scarf across a bench. A moment later, the scarf is tied around a ceiling pipe.
Someone places a pen inside a drawer. A moment later, the pen is balanced on a window ledge.
